Tossing, turning, and falling... like raindrops into the sea, your thoughts sink into the "dream." All that builds the dream stems from the misty illusions of yesterday. Welcome to pick the truths roaming the edge of consciousness and reality.
The haze fades like a receding tide, and my body finally breaks free from the void, returning to reality.
It's like waking up from a deep sleep, and everything around me isn't the world I know.
My brain's still muddled, unable to sort out my jumbled thoughts.
Triss? What are you doing here? Do you... Do you know where we are?
That voice... sounds familiar, but it's not Triss...
Naka?! I didn't expect you to bear such a striking resemblance to Triss in person...
...It seems you haven't come across a portrait of the founder of Catto City, or perhaps you've seen it before but forgotten.
I made a promise to provide you with my utmost assistance.
Dreams are an extension of the subconscious, intricately linked to our consciousness... I possess the ability to influence dreams to some extent.
However, your dreams are currently unable to withstand excessive power. What I'm utilizing now is an image already present in your consciousness.
Dreams have weird logic but have their own way of connecting things.
Well, actually... my brain's not clear right now...
...Simply put, Triss holds some special place in your subconscious. Maybe there's a special bond between you, or something else.
You mean, you don't know why either?
Ahem. Linking consciousness doesn't mean reading it. I can't see into your deep subconscious, so you'll have to explore it yourself...
I figured moving as a cat would be hard, but the electrical installations here are quite low, perfect for a cat's size.
Is this what they call cat-friendly?
This place looks like a warehouse though? It appears to have been abandoned for quite some time, yet the power system still functions...
By the way, do you happen to remember where we are?
I am still relatively unfamiliar with this location thus far.
Pathos Shards drifting in the dream.
While you're awake, the emotions you unintentionally or deliberately ignore don't just vanish.
They roam freely here and may resurface at certain, not necessarily opportune, moments...
Disrupting your dreams, emotional state, and even logical thinking...
Maybe it's best to collect them right now.
So, I might go nuts someday if I don't deal with them—is that what you mean?
In places beyond my sight, your emotions, or rather, your mental activities, must be quite vivid...
Is this... a cat's paw print?
Perfectly symmetrical, it's a textbook cat paw print.
...Normal cats apply pressure to different parts of their paws when they jump...
So how could there be such a symmetrical paw print?
As you mentioned, the assumption is a "normal cat."
...This is the edge of the dream.
I, as a whole, am being influenced by Pathos...
What you currently witness is the utmost effort that "I" can muster.
Rushing it might shatter your dream—that's not what I want.
Once your strength grows, your dream might be able to bear more power.
As you delve deeper, your consciousness will sink further... more clues will appear then...
The voice in my ear is faint.
You're not... alone... I will also...
I can feel the warm energy slowly receding.
The unshakable sense of chaos wraps around me again, making me feel like I'm sinking into the deep sea, and even opening my eyes seems impossible.
Explore around to find possible exits.
Go upstairs to see what's there.

What's going on? If there's a problem, let me know immediately.
You saw that huge lantern at the harbor, right? The locals carry small ones to hold a ceremony around it. Then, they light the huge lantern and make wishes.
That's right! This is one of the most important local festivals.\nQuick, follow me! And don't forget to light your lantern to make a wish!
Everyone's wishes will definitely come true!
I wanted to ask you for some details, Dr. Yunpei. It appears that the one who gave us the commission this time is your acquaintance.
Yes. I wondered, seeing as the Time-bending hourglass is so very important. Why is it entrusted to someone so young?

I told you before, we and Ying went to school together at Yore Manor. Ying has always been gifted, particularly with identification and restoration. She is unmatched among her peers, despite her inexperience.
We lost touch after leaving the Manor. I never expected that she would go to the Antiquities Atrium after leaving school!\nShe said she went there to hone her skills.
With such high praise from you, I imagine the owner of Antiquities Atrium also has their own considerations.
It's nothing important, Inspector. I'm just curious…
Hey, you've been out here alone for a while. Got something on your mind?
Not really, no. I've just been away for a while and wanted to get a good look.
I get that. You guys are always busy in the lab at the Science Research Division. No wonder you hardly have any free time!
Yeah, that's why we do our best to get back here for the festival.
Whenever I see this street again, it reminds me of when we were kids.\nExcept now, we're all grown up!
That's true.\nIn any case, since you so rarely make it to Lunar City, have you had a chance to wander around and check it out?
Yes. There are so many stores and booths for the festival over by the harbor. I was able to buy a lot of local specialties to bring back to the Squad. I hope they like them!
Hah! Everyone will be very happy with them!
Ah, you caught me!\nI've wanted to come take a look at your shop since you opened it! What do you recommend?
Oh, of course! Let's see, this is an enamel incense burner of the type common to the residents of Yaozhou. You can use it for soothing incense and herbs. Personally, I like it a lot!
I can see that!\nI wonder though, since you like them so much, why don't you just buy them for yourself? Why open a whole store?
To make money, of course!\nHee-hee…my little joke.
Do I need a reason to share the things I love? Introducing new people to what I care about, and making money at the same time. Great, isn't it?
That does sound like something you'd say!
Would you believe me if I said it wasn't a coincidence?
You're an important guest! I'll believe anything you say!
Ah, don't say that! I'd be embarrassed to go back empty-handed.\nI'm curious, though, what brought you here this time, Linn?
I was interested in the Lantern Rite. The customs here are so different from Catto City, so I was curious!
That's just exactly why, when I heard that Dr. Yunpei and the others were coming back to Yaozhou for the festival, I asked if I could tag along.
Well, um… how did you and Linsho meet?
Look! I even learned how to make the lanterns while I've been here. Shall we go and release them together, Inspector?
How can I deny an invitation from you? Of course!
Oh! That's your question? How should I say this - pure coincidence. We got some help from him on an investigation before.
He was helpful? He didn't try to trick you, did he?
Haha, no…don't worry.\nI wonder though, what image of Linsho do you have in mind that you ask?
Huh, are you waiting for me?
Yes! It's so crowded here, I was worried you couldn't find me.\nIt's the most exciting part of the Lantern Rite now, don't miss it!

Remember, Inspector, I will be by your side, now and always.
Although we haven't known each other for long, I can already tell that you have a kind heart. Please don't get the wrong idea—I definitely don't dislike you. In fact, it's quite the opposite!
Even though I may have my flaws, I'm committed to keeping up with the team. In doing so, I hope to be of assistance to you as well.

I can't help but imagine the Manager's face brightening with joy when you spot that special someone. My classmates say that if you spend New Year's with a loved one, you'll both be blessed with happiness in the year ahead.
With peach blossom season just around the corner, why don't you join us in picking a branch, Manager? It's a delightful way to share good fortune and well wishes.
Every enigma in this world is connected through an intricate tapestry of cause and effect. Isn't it fascinating how this principle also applies to the serendipitous meetings we have with one another?
Inspector, it's a pleasure to make your acquaintance. While the future may hold uncertainties, know that you will always have a special place reserved in my heart.
As one chapter closes, a new beginning emerges. Are you ready to embark on a fresh adventure by my side, Inspector?
We've traversed a long and winding road together. If it's not too much to ask, I would be grateful for your guidance as we navigate the path ahead.

Dreams act as the liminal space where reality and fantasy intertwine, a gateway that connects the past and the future. On that note, how about we plan another rendezvous? This enchanting night is too delightful to let end, don't you think?
I've been swamped with work recently, so please give me a heads up if you need anything.\nAnd about me working for you long-term, you haven't forgotten, have you? It's a fantastic opportunity for me.
Isn't it wonderful to have a brilliant lady like me around? Haha, I feel the same way! Every day spent with you, Inspector, is a joy.

I took the liberty of penning this letter to express my gratitude for the courage you have instilled in me.\nScarlett will never forget.\nI will offer prayers to the gods day and night, asking for a smooth and peaceful start to the new year on your behalf.

It feels rather peculiar to write such a personal letter to you.\nJust because this is a private message doesn't mean you can take it easy!\nI'll be here to keep guiding and pushing you forward in the coming days!
I cherish the countless precious memories we've created together, Inspector. They are rare and invaluable moments that I hold dear. I hope we can continue working together in the future.
Time really does fly, doesn't it? I wonder, Inspector, do you realize how much you mean to me? My feelings for you run deeper than you might imagine.
Inspector, having been by your side for so long, I've witnessed your tireless dedication. Thank you for your unwavering commitment. I eagerly await the future that you will shape.
When we find ourselves on a path that diverges from our intended destiny, loneliness may creep in. But no matter where we are or what challenges we face, we will greet the dawn together.
One of the greatest joys in my life has been meeting you, Inspector. I hold you in the highest regard. Let us strive forward and become the heroes of tomorrow.
Ding! It's question time!\nWho is the person Poppy longs to see the most?\nThe answer is... the one reading this letter right now!
Inspector, it's a pleasure to make your acquaintance once more! I am excited about the prospect of collaborating with you again. I'll be counting on your support!
